android.desc:
🚀 One article a day. That's all it takes.

CodeRoutine delivers one carefully curated technical article each day — no endless feeds, no information overload. Just focused, sustainable growth.

✨ FREE FOR EVERYONE

AI Summaries
Short on time? Get the key takeaways instantly with AI-generated summaries.

Two-Voice AI Podcasts
Every article becomes a natural conversation between two hosts. Listen while you commute, work out, or cook.

Curated Tech Feed
Stay in the loop with handpicked articles from top tech sources, right on your home screen.

Weekly Digest
A recap of the week's best articles so you never miss what matters.

Notes & Bookmarks
Take notes while reading. Bookmark articles and find them easily with tags.

Streaks & Progress
Build a reading streak, track expertise across topics, and watch your growth.

💎 PREMIUM

Full Archive — Browse every past article, not just the last 3 days.
AI Q&A — Ask up to 10 questions per article, answered from the full content.
AI Translations — Summaries in Italian, Spanish, German, or French.
Enhanced Analytics — Weekly reading charts and detailed streak history.
Unlimited Backlog — 30 days to catch up on delayed articles.
Personalized Digest — Tailored to your reading habits.

🎯 HOW IT WORKS

1. Open the app. Today's article is waiting.
2. Read it, get the AI summary, or listen as a podcast — your choice.
3. Mark as read. Build your streak.
4. Bookmark what you love. Move on.

🏆 BUILT FOR

Developers who want to stay current without the noise.
Students building knowledge one day at a time.
Anyone who's tired of doomscrolling and wants to grow instead.

Start your routine today.

Made with ❤️ for the global developer community.

show_hn.title: Show HN: CodeRoutine – one tech article per day, AI summaries and podcasts

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I’ve been building CodeRoutine to solve a problem I had: a lightweight way to learn consistently without infinite feeds. The app shows one handpicked CS/tech article each day and helps you build a reading habit. No accounts required; data stays on device (except minimal anonymous analytics like read count).

What it does

- Daily article: one curated piece per day across CS/software topics
- Streaks/progress: mark “read” within 24h; see your streaks and topic XP (+1 per topic)
- AI summaries: quick key points when time is tight
- Podcast mode: auto-generated audio to listen on the go
- Translations: summaries in IT/ES/DE/FR
- Offline reading (summaries), favorites, dark/light theme
- Privacy-first: local by default; optional cloud sync planned

Under the hood

- React Native + Expo
- Firebase Firestore for articles; anonymous analytics (read count, likes, dislikes)
- Google Cloud (Functions, Vertex AI) for summaries, translations, podcasts
- Push notifications via Expo; no authentication required for core use

Why I built it

- I keep a long backlog of tech articles but often don’t finish them. “One article per day” adds urgency without overwhelm, and the streak mechanic keeps me honest.

Try it / Source

- GitHub (OSS, MIT): https://github.com/edodusi/coderoutine-oss
- Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.edodusi.coderoutine

What I’m looking for

- Feedback on habit design (24h window, streaks): motivating or annoying?
